# EuvinoPRO design system

> React components and tokens from the EuvinoPRO Figma library. Import from `@euvino/ds`. Every value is a `var(--eu-*)` token.

Read first: [Rules for agents](AGENTS.md). Ask: `npm run ds -- list | describe <Name> | token <words> | check <file>`.

## Foundations

- `Icon` (Beta, v0.1): Draws one icon from the system's Iconoir set. It takes the surrounding text colour. Import icons through this, never from an icon package.
- `Stack` (Beta, v0.1): Lays out a row or column with a space token between children. Use it instead of hand-written flex and margins. It is the code form of auto layout in Figma.
- `Text` (Beta, v0.1): Any text set in a library text style and colour token. Use it for headings, paragraphs and captions instead of raw font sizes.
- `VisuallyHidden` (Beta, v0.1): Text for screen readers only, such as a table caption or a live status line.

## Content

- `Divider` (Beta, v0.1): Separates groups of content. Prefer spacing first; add a line only when spacing is not enough.
- `Badge` (Beta, v0.1): Shows a status, count or category. It is not interactive; use Chip for something people click.
- `Avatar` (Beta, v0.1): A person as picture or initials.
- `AvatarGroup` (Beta, v0.1): Several people in a small space. Show at most 4.
- `ListItem` (Beta, v0.1): One row of a List.
- `List` (Beta, v0.1): Rows of related items, such as settings, devices or files. For sortable columns of data use Table.
- `ProductThumbnail` (Beta, v0.1): Product image tile for tables and lists.
- `EmptyState` (Beta, v0.1): Shown when there is nothing to display. Say why and offer the next action.
- `TimelineItem` (Beta, v0.1): One event in a Timeline.
- `Timeline` (Beta, v0.1): Chronological list of events, such as request history or an activity log.
- `ActivityItem` (Beta, v0.1): A rich event in a Timeline, such as an email or a call, shown as a card next to an icon marker. Figma: Email Activity Item.
- `AccordionItem` (Beta, v0.1): One expandable row of an Accordion.
- `Accordion` (Beta, v0.1): Stacked expandable sections, when people need only some of the content.
- `Card` (Beta, v0.1): The one surface for grouped content: white, radius/xl, soft shadow. The Figma Card/* layouts are all this with different content. Do not stack cards inside cards.
- `KeyValueList` (Beta, v0.1): Label and value pairs, such as the details of a record. Figma: Key Value Pair.
- `Table` (Beta, v0.1): Table only: toolbars, filters and Pagination sit around it. Rows tint on hover. Header checkbox selects all. Selected rows get the accent tint.
- `LabelPicker` (Beta, v0.1): Shows a label as a Badge and lets people change it in place, such as in a table cell. A pencil appears on hover and focus.
The popover has a search, the labels as badges (the current one checked) and an add button for a new label.
Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes. It is positioned against the window, so table scrolling never cuts it off.
- `InlineEdit` (Beta, v0.1): A value that people change in place, such as a table cell or a detail field. A pencil appears on hover and focus.
Text: Enter or leaving the field saves, Escape cancels. Date: picking a day saves, Escape cancels.

## Actions and navigation

- `LinkButton` (Beta, v0.1): A text link that navigates. Use Button when it runs an action.
- `SegmentedControl` (Beta, v0.1): Switches the display of the same content in place, such as List and Grid. Not for page navigation (TopNav). Segments share the width equally, sized to the longest label.
- `Chip` (Beta, v0.1): An interactive pill for filters and tags. Use Badge for something that only shows a status.
- `Button` (Beta, v0.1): Runs an action. Start the label with a verb and name the result: "Create request", not "OK". Default type is `button`, so set `type="submit"` in forms.
- `IconButton` (Beta, v0.1): A Button that shows only an icon (Content = Only Icons in Figma). The label is required because nothing else names it.
- `Menu` (Beta, v0.1): Runs a command from a list, such as a row's actions. Arrow keys and Escape work. To choose a value use Dropdown.
- `TopNav` (Beta, v0.1): Links between views within a section, with a navy underline on the current one. This is also what other libraries call Tabs.
- `SideNav` (Beta, v0.1): Left navigation between app sections, 240 wide or a 72 rail when collapsed. A collapsed rail can be `expandable`; with `overflow` it never runs out of room.
- `Breadcrumbs` (Beta, v0.1): Shows where a page sits and links back up the trail.
- `Pagination` (Beta, v0.1): Moves through a long list page by page. It collapses long ranges with an ellipsis. Place it below the Table, never inside.
- `Steps` (Beta, v0.1): Shows progress through a multi-step process and marks the current step with `aria-current`. It shows progress only; the Back and Next buttons are yours.
- `FilterTabs` (Beta, v0.1): Filter tabs (pill tabs): one choice from many filters for the list below, such as a history feed.
Use SegmentedControl for 2 to 4 equal options, Chip for several filters at once, TopNav for views.
- `UserMenu` (Beta, v0.1): Profile trigger for the Header. Wrap it in Menu to add the account commands.
- `SplitButton` (Beta, v0.1): Main action plus a menu of related actions, split by a divider (Hydra "Button Select").
Use it when one action is the usual choice and a few others belong to it, such as "Kontakt" with "Import".

## Inputs

- `Dropdown` (Beta, v0.1): Choose one value from a list. It opens below the field and supports the arrow keys. To run commands use Menu; for two to four visible choices use Radio or SegmentedControl.
- `RadioGroup` (Beta, v0.1): A labelled set of Radio options. Use it for two to five visible choices.
- `Stepper` (Beta, v0.1): Change a small number with plus and minus buttons, such as a quantity.
- `Slider` (Beta, v0.1): Pick a value on a range. Use Input when an exact number is required.
- `FileDropzone` (Beta, v0.1): Drag-and-drop area over a real file input. List chosen files with FileItem.
- `FileItem` (Beta, v0.1): One uploaded file with its progress, result and a remove action.
- `TagInput` (Beta, v0.1): Enter several values as removable tags. Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes the last one.
- `Calendar` (Beta, v0.1): Month grid for picking one day. Use DatePicker for the field-plus-calendar pattern.
- `DatePicker` (Beta, v0.1): A field that opens a Calendar. Use it for dates near today; use Input for known dates such as birthdays.
- `SearchField` (Beta, v0.1): Search box with a suggestion list (combobox). Type to see matches, arrow keys to move, Enter to open one, Escape to close. Width is size/field-lg.
- `Input` (Beta, v0.1): Single-line text entry. `type="password"` adds a built-in show or hide button, so never build one yourself. For choosing from a list use Dropdown.
- `Textarea` (Beta, v0.1): Multi-line text entry for comments and descriptions. Use Input for single-line values.
- `Checkbox` (Beta, v0.1): Pick several options that need saving. For one choice of several use Radio. For a setting that applies at once use Toggle.
- `Radio` (Beta, v0.1): One option of a set where exactly one is chosen. Group them in RadioGroup.
- `Toggle` (Beta, v0.1): A switch for a setting that takes effect immediately. If the change needs saving, use Checkbox.
- `GlobalSearch` (Beta, v0.1): App-wide search: a header field that opens a large panel over a dimmed page, with categories on the left and
hits on the right. Matches are highlighted. Arrow keys move through hits, Enter opens one, Escape closes.
For a simple field with a short suggestion list use SearchField.

## Feedback and overlays

- `Loader` (Beta, v0.1): Indeterminate loading indicator. Use Skeleton when the layout is known and ProgressBar when the duration is known.
- `Skeleton` (Beta, v0.1): Placeholder while content loads. Match the layout that will appear. Hidden from screen readers; announce loading with `aria-busy` on the region.
- `ProgressBar` (Beta, v0.1): Progress when the duration or amount is known.
- `Alert` (Beta, v0.1): A message that stays on the page until resolved. `error` and `warning` announce themselves. Use Toast for a passing confirmation.
- `ToastProvider` (Beta, v0.1): Wrap the app or screen once. Then call `useToast()` anywhere inside. It renders the announcing region for you.
- `Modal` (Beta, v0.1): A focused task above the page, with a free content area such as a short form. For a yes-or-no confirmation use ConfirmDialog.
- `ConfirmDialog` (Beta, v0.1): The Pop-Up in Figma: a short confirmation before a consequential action. Use it for every delete or anything that cannot be undone. Focus starts on the safe choice.
- `Drawer` (Beta, v0.1): Side panel for details or edits while keeping the page in view.
- `Tooltip` (Beta, v0.1): Short hint on hover or focus. It never holds the only copy of important text. For richer content use Popover.
- `Popover` (Beta, v0.1): Small panel attached to a control, with richer content than a Tooltip. Escape and an outside press close it.

## Screen parts

- `BrandLogo` (Beta, v0.1): The product wordmark.
- `Header` (Beta, v0.1): App header bar. Renders a `header` landmark.
- `PageHeader` (Beta, v0.1): Page title, subtitle and primary action. Use one per page, at the top of the content.
- `Footer` (Beta, v0.1): Page footer with legal text and links.

## Charts

- `BarChart` (Beta, v0.1): Compare values across categories. Colours come from chart/1 to chart/6.
- `LineChart` (Beta, v0.1): A trend over time.
- `DonutChart` (Beta, v0.1): Parts of a whole, 2 to 6 segments.
- `Gauge` (Beta, v0.1): One score against a full range, drawn as a half circle.
- `ProgressList` (Beta, v0.1): Labelled progress bars in a list.
- `Stat` (Beta, v0.1): One KPI: label, value and change.
- `DataCard` (Beta, v0.1): Card for any chart, with an optional row of Stat.
